title: Nonadiabatic Holonomic Single-Qubit Gates in Non-Hermitian Systems
abstract: A nonadiabatic holonomic approach for driven three-level systems under non-unitary dynamics. A biorthogonal framework with tailored complex pulses enforces exact closure of the computational-subspace evolution without cyclic evolution, folding decay and dephasing across all eigenstates directly into pulse design and maintaining gate fidelity despite dissipation -- an advance over previous non-Hermitian treatments.
key_claims: A biorthogonal (left/right eigenstate) framework supports exact subspace-closure gate construction in genuinely non-unitary, dissipative settings.
Decay and dephasing across all eigenstates are incorporated directly into the pulse/observable design rather than treated perturbatively.
Demonstrates a worked biorthogonal-observable methodology in a non-Hermitian system -- the same metric/biorthogonal machinery HYP-028 needs for a real non-unitary fixed-point force test.
relevance_note: WATCH. Method/gate-synthesis paper, NOT a physics-result challenging anchors (no alpha, no transport, no CFT-universality claim). Catalogued because it is directly on-pathway for HYP-028 (INCONCLUSIVE, SIM-053): SIM-053 showed the uniform i*gamma Ising realization is structurally obstructed (Yang-Lee point sits AT the PT-breaking edge, kappa_c ~ 1/N), and the result note flags that a real test needs a biorthogonal / metric-inner-product formulation that stays PT-unbroken at a finite-distance fixed point. This paper's biorthogonal complex-pulse construction with dissipation folded into the design is a candidate template for that observable layer. Pairs with PAPER-2026-119 (seed of HYP-028).
anchor_contradiction: None. Orthogonal to alpha~4 (=2*Delta_T), transport residual ~-1.2% at N=16, and chi-bound anchors.
